question: A coin of diameter 4 cm is placed at a distance of 45 cm in front of a convex lens of focal length 30 cm. Then the diameter of the image of the coin will be:
solution:
The correct answer is __**8 cm**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Given: u=-45cm, f=30cm

Using the lens formula, (1)/(f)=(1)/(v)-(1)/(u)

Rightarrow (1)/(30)=(1)/(v)-(1)/(-45)

Rightarrow (1)/(v)=(1)/(30)-(1)/(45)=(3-2)/(90)=(1)/(90)

Thus, v=90cm

Using magnification formula, m=(v)/(u)=(90)/(-45)=-2 (negative sign indicates, image will be inverted).

Diameter of image = m * Diameter of the object = -2×4cm=8cm.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Convex Lens:**

 
 
• A convex lens is a converging lens that converges light rays passing through it to a point.
 
• It has a positive focal length.
 
• Convex lenses are used in various optical instruments like cameras, magnifying glasses, and eyeglasses.
 
 
 
• **Lens Formula:**
 
 
• The lens formula is given by: (1)/(f)=(1)/(v)-(1)/(u) where f is the focal length of the lens, v is the image distance from the lens, and u is the object distance from the lens.
 
• The distances are measured from the optical center of the lens, with the convention that distances measured in the direction of the incident light are positive, and those against the direction are negative.
 
 
 
• **Magnification:**
 
 
• Magnification (m) is given by the ratio of the height of the image (h_ihi" id="MathJax-Element-54-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">hi" id="MathJax-Element-87-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">hi hi hi ) to the height of the object (h_o) and can also be expressed as the ratio of the image distance (v) to the object distance (u): m=(h_i)/(h_o)=(v)/(u)
 
• In this case, the diameter of the coin is used instead of height, as both are proportional.
